newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Sugar firm pushes down Mauritius share index.
newsitem.headline: Sugar firm pushes down Mauritius share index.

text.p: Falling share price of sugar concern Mon Tresor Mon Desert pushed down the Mauritius bourse index by 1.34 points to 367.87 on Monday amid a market where other stock prices moved within thin ranges, brokers said.
Volume totalled 15.92 million rupees on 476,592 shares from 21.19 million rupees on 576,296 shares on Friday.
Brokers said the main factor behind the falling index was Mon Tresor Mon Desert (MTMD) which slumped by 2.40 rupees to 38.10 on 13,370 shares.
"MTMD is becoming a good buy at this sort of price level. Just think what type of earnings it will have after its production capacity will rise by the merger," a broker said.
He was referring to MTMD's intended acquisition of three sugar factories from its holding company, Swaziland-based Lonrho Sugar Corporation.

MTMD shares recently gained some 25 percent to a peak of 42 rupees after announcement of the merger which would make MTMD one of the leading sugar producing firms in Mauritius with an expected production capacity of 84,000 tonnes per year from 31,000 tonnes.

Shares in the rest of the market were little changed and brokers said foreign investors again bought stocks of leading companies Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB), State Bank of Mauritius, New Mauritius Hotels and conglomerate Rogers.

MCB was unchanged at 86 rupees on 32,049 shares, State Bank of Mauritius remained at 11.10 rupees on 134,400 shares. Rogers gained 1.0 to 100 on 52,831 shares and New Mauritius Hotels edged up by 10 cents to 34 rupees on 115,627 shares.

Promotion And Development was down 20 cents to 16.20 rupees on 6,300 shares and National Investment Trust eased 10 cents to 12.90 rupees on 1,450 shares. Harel Freres slumped by 3.20 rupees to 49.80 on a thin 50 shares.
Grand Baie Hotel was up 10 cents to 41.40 rupees on 2,500 shares and national carrier Air Mauritius was unchanged at 44 rupees on 550 shares.
